FN-HI7H668-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 319
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 319 as introduced would prohibit state agencies from settling claims against the
state unless the agency has sufficient funds to pay the full amount of the settlement. This bill
would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
